title: Japan’s Sumitomo Bakelite expands China chip packaging materials output amid AI boom
text:
Japanese semiconductor materials giant Sumitomo Bakelite plans to expand production of advanced chip packaging materials in China and Singapore, marking the second such announcement for its Chinese operations in less than four months as artificial intelligence drives demand for more sophisticated semiconductors.
